title: Remboy perfect
description: It brings all the optimization and visual improvements from vanilla that look perfect with vanilla Minecraft.
body:
![It's the title of the modpack that's about optimization and vanilla visual improvements for Minecraft Java.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab4df8ca7358d93ce5474b3b9d020b1b51b8b5dd.png)
### What is it about:
It is a modpack that gives an FPS improvement of about x4 (400%), therefore it provides maximum performance and includes animations that enhance the player experience without consuming almost any performance.

### 📊Performance:                                                                                        
**Test**       |      **Avg FPS**    |   **Min FPS**   |    **Max FPS**                            
:---      |  :---        |    :---   |   :---                        
Remboy perfect   |   340            |       256            |360
Vanilla            |    147               |   117            |168

##### Tested on 12 chunks render and 5 shadow distance. With Intel graphics, Intel i5 210H.On more powerful PCs they achieve 4x or even 6x.

### Main features:
#### Maximum performance:
Select the mods that give you the maximum possible performance and are configured. Reducing RAM usage and stutters on all types of devices.
#### More or less light::
Since it only includes optimization mods and vanilla visual enhancements that hardly consume any performance. Downloading it doesn't take up much space.
#### It works on all types of platforms:
By only including optimization mods and vanilla visual improvements that consume almost no performance, it allows you to use it in worlds and servers with ease because it does not bring content that alters the game and it remains vanilla.
#### 🌍Continuous updates:
Our purpose is to improve your FPS and give you vanilla visual enhancements (it hardly affects performance), which allows us to make updates more continuously.                 
#### Choose your shaders or add your favorite resource packs:
You can choose your shaders and resource packs thanks to the installer being inside the game, you won't have to go to Modrinth or CurseForge to install them, which takes time because if you use Modrinth or CurseForge you have to move them to Modrinth or .minecraft and put them in their folders.                           
### Recommendation:
Now that you know everything about the modpack, we would recommend that you [install the modpack.](https://modrinth.com/modpack/remboy-optimized/versions)
### ✅Installation guide:
- Download the Modrinth app with the browser or other launchers that allow the installation of Modrinth modpacks.
- Install the Remboy perfect modpack in "browser" in the Modrinth app.
- **¡Open the game** and enjoy a smoother experience and vanilla visual improvements! (they barely consume performance).

<details>
<summary>FAQ</summary>
Q:¿Will it be made for older versions?
  
R:Yes, but later, if the demand is high, we could raise it faster.

                                                          
Q:¿What mods or  resource Packs does the modpack have?                                               
R:It is in "credits and links", there is the complete list of mods and resource packs.           

Q:¿Why doesn't it include (mods or resource packs that modify the game)?                                   
R:Because we want them to have the highest possible performance and vanilla visual improvements (they don't consume much).                                

Q:¿Do I need a pack on the server?                                   
R:No, the modpack works on all servers that allow vanilla clients.                     

Q:¿How does installing shaders or resource packs inside the game work?                          
R:It works by giving you access to the Modrinth and CurseForge websites, and you can choose between the two platforms, and if you install something, it will directly put it in the shaders or resourcepacks folder.
</details>
